rationale: The stock gapped up ~9% on a mixed earnings report (revenue beat, significant EPS miss) and has already run from $17.50 open to $19.53 high, now sitting at 87% of today's range with volume decelerating sharply in the last few candles (167 and 273 shares). The 9-EMA at $19.36 is above current price suggesting short-term momentum has rolled over, but the stock is still well above VWAP ($18.97), making a clean short entry risky.
